wolf-verschwiegene-liebe.key: two flats at the start; two sharps from bar 6, two flats from bar 13, two sharps from bar 15 to the end (closing in D major)
wolf-verschwiegene-liebe.time: 12/8, with single bars of 6/8 at bars 8, 17 and 23
wolf-verschwiegene-liebe.tempoBasis: from three complete recordings, median 2:20 (Kaufmann/Deutsch 2:16, Bostridge/Pappano 2:20, Oxford Lieder live, Stone Records, with Kynoch 2:55), 1.5 s allowed for silence; 26 bars and a pickup, mostly 12/8 with three bars of 6/8 = 147.5 quarter notes = 98.3 dotted quarters; Wolf marks it Sanfte Bewegung und immer sehr zart; the printed tempo changes are kept, in proportion, so the song lasts as long as in the recordings
wolf-verschwiegene-liebe.tempoWords: Sanfte Bewegung und immer sehr zart
